title: Add supplier purchase invoice register
description: Add a supplier purchase-invoice register for ordinary and special VAT invoice evidence, with optional authoritative allocation to existing Purchase Orders. The register is operational evidence only and is not an accounts-payable ledger, tax filing system or payment authorization mechanism. Repository schema code and non-production test validation are allowed; production database execution, real tax submission, payment, deployment and release are prohibited.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create and edit draft supplier invoices with invoice type, invoice code when applicable, invoice number, invoice date, Supplier, currency, net amount, tax amount, gross amount and notes; gross amount is validated against the documented amount equation and currency precision.
The server validates the Supplier and rejects missing, deleted or inactive Suppliers for new invoices while preserving bounded Supplier identity snapshots for historical reads.
Active invoice identity is unique for the same Supplier, invoice type and normalized code/number combination; duplicates are rejected rather than silently merged.

A draft invoice can allocate all or part of its gross amount to one or more existing non-cancelled Purchase Orders only when Supplier and currency match authoritatively; duplicate order links and allocations above invoice gross amount are rejected.
The invoice explicitly displays linked and unlinked amounts; an invoice may remain partially or wholly unlinked without the system guessing a Purchase Order from free text, amount or date similarity.
Users can record a draft invoice and later void it while preserving its identity, amounts, allocations and audit history; recorded or voided evidence is not hard-deleted or silently rewritten.
Recording or voiding an invoice does not change Purchase Order status, received quantity, inventory cost, tax-refund records, supplier balance, payment status or any production financial record.
Existing Suppliers and Purchase Orders remain valid without invoice data or production backfill.
Repository schema changes are idempotent and validated only through permitted local or test-database paths; production schema execution remains behind the mandatory human gate.

Unit/integration tests cover ordinary and special invoices, amount validation, duplicate identity, invalid Supplier, same-currency order allocation, mismatched Supplier/currency, partial linkage, void history and non-mutation of purchasing/finance records; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Create a supplier special VAT invoice, allocate it partially across compatible Purchase Orders and verify linked and unlinked amounts persist without changing the orders.
Attempt a duplicate invoice and a mismatched Supplier or currency allocation, verify both are rejected, then void a recorded invoice and verify its evidence remains readable.

human_gate.reason: Repository invoice-evidence code and non-production test schema only. No tax filing, payment authorization, production database action, deployment or release is authorized.
